title: Evangelion: 2.22 You Can (Not) Advance

title_lang.zh_hk: 新世紀福音戰士新劇場版：破

synopsis: Mari Makinami Illustrioous pilots Provisional Unit-05 to defeat the excavated Third Angel. Asuka Shikinami Langley and EVA-02 defeat the Seventh Angel. The Eighth Angel appears and attacks NERV HQ. EVA-03 is taken over by the Ninth Angel during testing and Shinji deploys to stop it, but learns Asuka is aboard. Gendoh switches EVA-01's controls over to the Dummy System and begins fighting EVA-03...

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 真希波‧真理‧伊盧崔亞斯駕駛EVA假設5號機，擊敗了被挖掘出的第3使徒；式波．明日香．蘭格雷駕駛EVA 2號機摧毀第7使徒；第8使徒出現後襲擊了NERV總部。EVA 3號機在測試過程中被第9使徒劫持，真嗣被派出去進行攔截，卻得知明日香在插入拴內。碇源堂將EVA初號機轉由模擬系統操控，開始迎擊EVA 3號機。
